title: Yummy Smoky Irish Salmon Grill
description: A smoky, crispy grilled salmon featuring a cacao-infused glaze, perfect for a sugar-free solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400°F (204°C) for medium-high heat.
Whisk cocoa powder, sugar-free maple syrup, miso paste, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper in a small bowl to make the glaze.
Brush the salmon lightly with olive oil and coat it with the glaze, reserving a small amount for later.
Place the salmon skin-side down on the grill and sear for 3 minutes until a crust forms.
Flip the salmon, brush with remaining glaze, and grill for 4 more minutes until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Remove from the grill and let it rest for 2 minutes.
Slice the salmon into thin sashimi-style pieces and arrange on a plate.
Serve immediately, optionally garnishing with fresh herbs or lemon wedges.
